name: Hermes
summary: Nous Research 的开源 agent：查看会话、状态和完整对话；在 tmux 中运行时可回复、确认、回答提问和中断
summaryEn: Nous Research's open-source agent: view sessions, status and full conversations; reply, confirm, answer questions and interrupt when it runs in tmux

cli.note: 回复和确认需要 Hermes 在 tmux 中运行
Windows 上没有 tmux，只能查看
回复和确认需要 Hermes 在 tmux 中运行

limitsNote: Hermes 使用你自己配置的模型服务（Nous Portal、OpenRouter 等），额度和余额请在对应服务的控制台查看，「今日用量」中不显示；token 和花费按 Hermes 自己的记录统计
limitsNoteEn: Hermes uses the model provider you configure (Nous Portal, OpenRouter and others), so check quota and balance in that provider's console; they aren't shown under Today's usage. Tokens and spend are counted from Hermes's own records
speaker: Hermes
notes: 新接入 Hermes：查看会话和完整对话；在 tmux 中运行时可从手机回复、确认危险命令、回答提问、中断和关闭会话；用量统计计入 Hermes 的 token 和花费。
notesEn: New: Hermes support. View sessions and full conversations; when it runs in tmux, reply, confirm dangerous commands, answer questions, interrupt and close sessions from your phone. Usage stats include Hermes's tokens and spend.
